qa.answer: 有评价说穿着很舒服，但没有足弓支撑，鞋底泡棉也会逐渐压实。评价没有明确说明是否适合整天站立。（30 条评论里有 1 条提到）

qa.answer: One reviewer noticed the foam sole was getting a little compressed after about three months of indoor use, but didn’t say it had worn out. 1 of 30 reviews mention this.
